capabilities: Mirror selected notes and folders to a Cloudflare R2 bucket
Expose the mirror as a remote MCP server endpoint
Search and read notes through MCP tools
Upload only attachments referenced by permitted notes
Optionally sync notes two-way between devices
disambiguation: Not an in-vault AI chat client; it mirrors selected notes to a remote MCP server that outside AI apps read.
extras: Windows setup uses a downloadable wizard; macOS, Linux and CLI users follow a separate manual setup guide. Licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. MCP clients have no write access to the mirror; writes go through Obsidian URIs.
motivation: The author wanted tools to do what they are best at: write in Obsidian, ask directly in any remote AI, and read from any device, even when the vault's computer is off.
problem: Remote AI clients cannot reach a vault unless the computer holding it is powered on and the AI runs on the same device.

relations.evidence: Context Anywhere syncs your selected notes to your own Cloudflare account

requires.name: AI client supporting remote MCP and OAuth
Cloudflare R2 (payment method required, free tier available)

summary: Syncs chosen notes and referenced attachments to a private Cloudflare mirror and serves them to remote MCP AI clients for read-only search and reading.
